snippet.title: Darwin’s Paradox! | Gameplay Trailer | KONAMI (ESRB)
snippet.description:
Dive into the depths of the unknown with Darwin’s Paradox, an action-adventure platformer where you play as Darwin, a curious octopus, unwittingly tasked to save the world. With tentacles of talent and a heart full of wonder, Darwin must unleash his abilities to survive an unforgettable journey. Coming 2026 to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and Steam. Wishlist now!

For more information on Darwin’s Paradox!, visit: https://www.konami.com/games/darwins_paradox/
